No visible text overlap, horizontal clipping, or missing prose glyphs was observed.

A thin horizontal rule visibly separates the introductory energy-exchange narrative from the bold English heading 'Total mechanical energy' in both full-page images. The heading, following explanation, and equation (1.27) have clear vertical separation.

The earlier instructional spring schematic is present once in each lesson view, following the prose that identifies it as schematic rather than measured data. The schematic scales from the report's 640-pixel desktop media width to 358 pixels on mobile; labels remain readable and contained. Panel c is treated as generic compressed displacement, not a measured left turning point. This is display observation only, not renewed science or geometry approval.
